north_star: Reliable local email imports in Obsidian with honest installation and compatibility guarantees.
wedge: Apple Mail and Outlook email drops on macOS.
target_user: Obsidian desktop users importing email and documents.
core_promise: Preserve original email bytes and create readable linked entries in the intended note.
product_principles: Local processing and explicit external file access.
success_metrics: A standard plugin installation works as documented and review gates have reproducible evidence.
